name: 11038-longdecode-8b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine on the V1 engine architecture.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup the first 25% by completion, bounded at 1024 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 256 tokens, output exactly 1024 (`ignore_eos`). Sampling parameters as declared in configs/scenario.json.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter writing assistant turning short prompts into 1024-token drafts for 256 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line: commit 5ed5d5f128d26a48c1b1db16c319fcb96c93799d
# (`git describe` = v0.6.4.post1-285-g5ed5d5f128).

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-seqs: 256
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false

# HAZARD: this setup is declared over the V1 engine, selected only by VLLM_USE_V1=1
# (configs/tuned.yaml). At this commit an engine built in-process from `vllm.AsyncLLMEngine`
# gets the V0 class regardless of the flag, and runs to completion on the wrong architecture.
